Equipment

Picocare450 Nd.YAG

Picocare is a true pico laser offering the shortest pulse duration of 450 ps @ 1300 MW. Picocare 450 is an Nd: YAG picosecond laser system to treat tattoo colors & pigmented lesions. Picocare minimizes damage to the skin to remove pigment by precisely aiming at the target spot.In terms of speed & comfort, its performance is superior to any other device in the market. PicoCare PicoSecond Nd:YAG laser is an absolute forefront of current laser technology.
